svg.title: The stack, from servo to company
svg.desc: Three layers, animated in four beats. 1, heal offline: on the bench the STM32 sensor pod talks serial to podd and its 38 heal tools, the local healer agent (qwen3.5:4b) works only through those tools, and the arm host drives the SO-101. 2, report up: the edge bridge and the arm host send runs, check-ins and incidents to the Romulus cloud (FastAPI and Postgres), which files labelled runs and work orders. 3, agents act: the Naïve technician agent takes hardware faults and ends at one human click; the fleet-doctor agent reviews failure clusters and sends a rule or skill to the gate (replay, sim canary, promote) and to the Naïve board. 4, ship back: the gate sends new versions to the arm host, and the board sends job cards to the Hermes commander, which drives the arm with named skills.
svg.text: The stack, from servo to company
